Space.title: Space
Space.description: Represents a unique shared space for two participants.

slug.description: A unique, URL-friendly identifier for the space.

displayName.description: The display name of the space.

spacePasswordHash.description: The hashed password for the space lobby.

publicEnabled.description: Indicates if the space has a public area.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the space was created.

Member.title: Member
Member.description: Represents a participant within a space.

spaceId.description: The ID of the space this member belongs to.

displayName.description: The display name of the participant.

claimed.description: Indicates if the member has claimed their account.

passwordHash.description: The hashed password for the member.

passwordSetBy.description: The member ID who set this password.

claimCodeId.description: A reference to a one-time claim code.

lastSeen.description: Timestamp of the member's last activity.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the member was created.

ClaimCode.title: ClaimCode
ClaimCode.description: Represents a one-time code for a member to claim their account.

id.description: Unique identifier for the claim code.

spaceId.description: The ID of the space this code is for.

qrData.description: Data for generating a QR code.

claimedByMemberId.description: The ID of the member who claimed this code.

revoked.description: Indicates if the code has been revoked.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the code was created.

Content.title: Content
Content.description: Represents a piece of content within a space.

spaceId.description: The ID of the space this content belongs to.

authorMemberId.description: The ID of the member who authored this content.

definition.description: Stores members belonging to a space.
Stores one-time claim codes for a space.
